summary: Show photos from your computer as a slideshow, with the screen on or waking on a schedule.
page_description: Turn a Kobo into a low-power black-and-white photo frame. Send albums from your computer, then choose a slideshow that keeps the screen on or wakes the reader every few hours.
release_notes: Clearer description and setup steps in the Store. No change to how the app works.

steps.text: Once per reader: with it plugged in over USB, run kobo setup --enable-ssh. Then save it so the commands below find it on Wi-Fi without an address.
Create Frame's photo folder on the reader.
Send a photo or a folder of photos.
